description:
Goal (2026-09-15): add Speechmatics as a cloud service for STT, diarization AND persistent speaker identification (live and batch), and replace the "Transcription service" radio (On this phone | Soniox) with one model picker per role where cloud services are options next to local models.

Why Speechmatics: the only public cloud API found that matches saved voiceprints in both realtime and batch (research 2026-09-15). pyannoteAI identify is batch-only (Live-1 streaming is diarization-only); Deepgram, AssemblyAI, Gladia, Soniox, xAI, ElevenLabs diarize but don't identify; Azure Speaker Recognition and Amazon Connect Voice ID are retired. Docs: https://docs.speechmatics.com/speech-to-text/features/speaker-identification

Speechmatics facts the plan relies on:
- Realtime: wss://<region>.rt.speechmatics.com/v2?jwt=<temp key>. Temp key: POST https://mp.speechmatics.com/v1/api_keys?type=rt, Bearer <long-lived key>, body {ttl: 60..3600}. Browser must use JWT, not Bearer.
- transcription_config.diarization = "speaker"; speaker_diarization_config.get_speakers = true returns identifiers at end of stream (or on GetSpeakers {final:true} -> SpeakersResult). speaker_diarization_config.speakers = [{label, speaker_identifiers: [...]}] labels enrolled voices in AddTranscript; others get S1, S2... speakers_sensitivity tunes enrolled matching. max_speakers counts only generic speakers.
- Enrollment clips 5-30 s. Max 50 identifiers per session. Identifiers are tied to the model version (not transferable), encrypted and isolated per customer/project.
- Batch jobs support the same speaker identification.

Settings direction (user request): API keys are just entries in a Services section. Every role (speech detection, live captions, final transcript, voice model, summary) is a dropdown listing local models AND cloud options. When a selected option intrinsically provides another role (Soniox/Speechmatics live streams do endpointing + diarization + final tokens, so speech detection and final transcript aren't needed), that role's dropdown auto-selects "Provided by <service>" and is disabled. Options whose requirement isn't met (no key, language unsupported, Speechmatics voice ID without Speechmatics audio) are disabled with a reason.

Privacy (plan.md §6/§10): cloud options stay explicit opt-in. Speechmatics voice identification means voiceprints (identifiers) exist on Speechmatics' side; this needs its own consent wording, distinct from "audio is streamed for transcription". Local stays the default.

```mermaid
graph LR
  R[1 selection registry + capability rules] --> UI[2 settings: services + per-role pickers]
  R --> P[3 pipeline dispatch by selection]
  S[4 Speechmatics WebView spike] --> L[5 Speechmatics live provider]
  P --> L
  L --> B[6 Speechmatics batch final transcript]
  L --> V[7 Speechmatics voice identification]
  B --> V
  UI --> V
  P --> SA[8 Soniox async final transcript]
```
title: Cloud services as selectable models; Speechmatics STT, diarization and voice identification
